notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates carry a red strip.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A silver car with four bars visible; all coverage is Generation 3, and no other similar landscape has this car.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Cyrillic with extra letters Ө, Ү and Ң missing from the northern neighbour's alphabet.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: All coverage was shot in winter: bare trees, drab landscapes and snow in many parts.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Trees and concrete poles are often painted white at the bottom.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Kilometre markers with a red-and-white triangle pattern, unique here.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Muslim majority, so mosques are common.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Coverage is very limited, so knowing covered roads and driving directions helps a lot.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: In the south the car mirror shows less road and a diagonal reflection; west of one southern city it carries dirt, and a small black dot marks another area.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Divided roads are mostly around the capital, plus a major highway east to the lake town.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The biggest lake can often be seen from the roads north and south of it, with no mountains in its direction.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The capital is the most developed city; snowy mountains lie south and smog hangs to the north.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Colourful poles with yellow, green, white and sometimes red tops east and west of the capital.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: The second city has southern-mirror coverage, decent weather, leafy trees and hills with radio masts in the centre.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: The third city has southern-mirror coverage with fully overcast sky.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Poles painted white at the bottom with red and yellow stripes.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Steep orange ridge to the north and big snow-capped mountains to the south; snow with red soil south of the town.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Sunny city between snow-capped mountains, with melting snow on the ground.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Gravel roads with dry rolling hills and snow patches near a high mountain lake.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A relatively green valley with orange rock formations.
